stimulus: Bhutan, known as the Jewel of the Eastern Himalayas, is a small country surrounded by Tibet and India. Its official name is Druk-yul, meaning ‘land of the thunder (a) -------’, due to the fierce storms from the Himalayas. Isolated by the mountains, Bhutan has developed a unique culture based on (b) ------- beliefs. Traditional dress includes the Gho for men and the Kira for women. Bhutanese festivals like Tshechus and Losar showcase colourful dances and masks. These festivals reflect the nation’s devotion to culture and religion. Bhutan is also deeply committed to protecting its (c) -------, with strict laws for preserving nature. Killing endangered animals like the black-necked crane can lead to life (d) -------. Bhutan is perhaps most famous for valuing Gross National Happiness over Gross National Product. In 2006, it was ranked the (e) -- ----- happiest country in Asia. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) dragon; (b) Buddhist; (c) environment; (d) imprisonment; (e) happiest;
